prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production macOS game app icon, one square 1024x1024 PNG.
Primary request: Create an elegant, premium macOS app icon for Castlevania: Lords of Shadow, inspired by the attached game cover.
Input image 1: visual reference for Gabriel Belmont's appearance, costume, and the moonlit gothic palette. It is reference artwork, not an edit target and not a layout to reproduce.
Subject: tightly framed three-quarter portrait of Gabriel Belmont, recognizable long dark hair, stern pale face turned slightly toward the left, vivid crimson shoulder mantle with restrained antique gold piping, layered ornate silver chest armor and a prominent armored gauntlet near the lower edge. His face and crimson shoulder must dominate, with a strong readable silhouette.
Scene/backdrop: a luminous ivory full moon at upper left and a subtle distant gothic castle silhouette in deep storm-blue mist. Keep background simple.
Style/medium: richly painted dark-fantasy game key art, realistic proportions, finely rendered metal, luxurious but restrained. Carefully art-directed icon rather than a cropped game box.
Composition/framing: exactly one centered large rounded-square macOS icon tile, about 88% of the canvas width and height, with smooth generous continuous corners and even transparent margins around it. All artwork is contained inside the tile. Gabriel fills most of the tile, dark hair and ivory moon create bold contrast, face readable at small sizes. A subtle graphite rim, crisp clean edges, restrained depth; no chunky frame.
Lighting/mood: dramatic cold blue moon rim light, warm highlights on face and crimson fabric, silver specular accents, rich dark navy shadows.
Constraints: actual transparent alpha outside the rounded-square tile; opaque illustrated interior. No lettering, no typography, no wordmarks, no app name, no age ratings, no publisher logos, no watermark, no white or checkerboard background, no extra icons, no mockup, no perspective tilt. Output just the finished square icon asset.
reference: User-provided Castlevania: Lords of Shadow cover artwork (visual reference only).
export: PNG resized to 1024 × 1024 with macOS sips, preserving generated alpha. ICNS was exported once with sips and iconutil and contains all 10 standard and Retina representations from 16 to 1024 pixels.
